scripts.dev: concurrently -n engine,ai,protocol,server,client -c yellow,cyan,magenta,green,blue "npm run dev -w @utopia/engine" "npm run dev -w @utopia/ai" "npm run dev -w @utopia/protocol" "npm run dev -w @utopia/server" "npm run dev -w @utopia/client"
scripts.build:libraries: npm run build -w @utopia/engine && npm run build -w @utopia/ai && npm run build -w @utopia/protocol
scripts.build: npm run build:libraries && npm run build -w @utopia/client && npm run build -w @utopia/server
scripts.build:server: npm run build:libraries && npm run build -w @utopia/server
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:libraries && npm run typecheck -w @utopia/engine && npm run typecheck -w @utopia/ai && npm run typecheck -w @utopia/protocol && npm run typecheck -w @utopia/server && npm run typecheck -w @utopia/client && npm run typecheck -w @utopia/tools
